query:
SELECT c.id, c.nameEn, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.imageUrl,
       ds.id as dataSourceId, ds.source, ds.sourceId, ds.url, ds.lastUpdatedAt
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId
WHERE c.id = 180009;
